title: The Rest Are Built
label: ch:mr-ordinals-sixth-to-tenth
canDo: I can build any ordinal from sixth upwards by putting -vaa on the number, and I know the one place between five and ten where the number underneath is an older form.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R61-sixth-to-tenth and run pahilaa to dahaavaa, then name the one of the ten that bent the rule and how.
payoff.note: Five ordinals, zero memorised. The chapter's evidence is checkable rather than asserted: Molesworth's 1857 dictionary carries pahilaa, duSraa, tiSraa and chauthaa as headwords and returns NO RESULT for sahaavaa, saatvaa, aaThvaa, navvaa or dahaavaa, because a dictionary records what a reader cannot derive.
